description: This file contains transformation logic and utility functions for context caching in a language model framework, specifically handling message processing, TTL extraction, message separation, and message transformation for Vertex AI integration.

classes.name: CachedContentRequestBody
classes.description: A data structure representing a request body for cached content, including message contents, model info, display name, and optional TTL and system instructions.

methods.name: int get_first_continuous_block_idx( filtered_messages: List[Tuple[int, AllMessageValues]] )
methods.description: Finds the index where the first continuous sequence of message blocks ends.

methods.name: Optional[str] extract_ttl_from_cached_messages(messages: List[AllMessageValues])
methods.description: Extracts the TTL value from cached messages if present and valid.

methods.name: bool _is_valid_ttl_format(ttl: str)
methods.description: Checks whether a TTL string is in a valid format (numeric value ending with 's').

methods.name: Tuple[List[AllMessageValues],List[AllMessageValues]] separate_cached_messages( messages: List[AllMessageValues], )
methods.description: Separates a list of messages into cached and non-cached segments based on message cache status.

methods.name: CachedContentRequestBody transform_openai_messages_to_gemini_context_caching( model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], custom_llm_provider: Literal["vertex_ai", "vertex_ai_beta", "gemini"], cache_key: str, vertex_project: Optional[str], vertex_location: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Transforms a list of messages into a cached content request body for Vertex AI, handling TTL extraction, message conversion, and system message processing.

ctags.name: transform_openai_messages_to_gemini_context_caching
ctags.signature: ( model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], custom_llm_provider: Literal["vertex_ai", "vertex_ai_beta", "gemini"], cache_key: str, vertex_project: Optional[str], vertex_location: Optional[str], )
